**Job Description For Head Of Technology**
 Brief about the Profile
   

  

* Profile Name: Head of Technology
* Education: BSC IT, BCA, B.E, B.Tech, MCA, MSC IT or related degrees
* Required Experience: 12 to 15 years
* Number of position: 1
* Location: Western line\- (Churchgate to Virar)
* Type: Full Time and Work from office


**Skills**
* 12\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong Technical Architecture and


 leadership experience
   

  

* Strong experience in Fintech, Lending/Loan solutions, LOS, and B2B applications.
* Strong understanding of Product Engineering, Microservices, SOA, database design, and scalable system architecture.
* Experience in PHP, Python, Kotlin, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL/MongoDB, AWS/Azure, and ELK/observability tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at senior and client levels.


**Responsibility**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap aligned with business and product objectives
* Lead solution architecture for scalable, high\-performance, secure, and reliable


 fintech/lending products.
   

  

* Drive end\-to\-end product engineering, technical delivery, and software quality.
* Provide technical leadership across Development, DevOps, Product, and Implementation teams.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, build POCs, and resolve complex technical challenges hands\-on when required.
* Drive adoption of AI/ML and emerging technologies to improve product capabilities, automation, and efficiency.
* Establish strong application security, data protection, and compliance practices across technology initiatives.
* Own cloud and infrastructure architecture across AWS/Azure, including availability,


 monitoring, performance, and cost optimization.
   

  

* Drive DevOps, CI/CD, release engineering, and reliable deployment practices.
* Establish architecture governance, coding standards, design principles, and engineering best practices
* Work closely with implementation teams to ensure smooth product integration with client environments.
* Act as a client\-facing technology representative for technical discussions, issue resolution, solutioning, and requirement understanding.
* Participate in client pitches, technical presentations, solution discussions, and pre\-sales engagements.
* Identify and evaluate new technologies, tools, frameworks, and platforms for business and product innovation.
* Mentor technical leaders and engineers and strengthen the overall technical capability of the organization.
* Collaborate with Product, Business, Operations, Implementation, and senior stakeholders to deliver technology outcomes.
